hero.title: Uses of Alloys
hero.lead: From refrigeration valves to aircraft frames, and from dental fillings to city bridges: alloys are used in many aspects of our lives. Learn in this lesson about their most prominent uses and their most famous examples.

objectives: Lists the uses of alloys in various areas of life.
States common examples of the alloys used in each area.

content.heading: 💡 8-7 Uses of Alloys
content.html: Alloys are used in many industrial, medical, and construction fields, thanks to the properties they have that are better than the pure metals that make them up.

content.sectionHeading: 🕹️ Interactive Simulation: Fields of Alloy Use
content.descriptionHtml: Press any field to learn how alloys are used in it.

labels.coolingText: Some alloys are used in manufacturing refrigeration-circuit valves and fire-detection systems, since they respond precisely to changes in temperature.
labels.medicalText: Certain alloys are used in medicine, such as fillings and bridges in dentistry, and the medical guidewire device.
labels.aircraftText: Some alloys are used in manufacturing aircraft frames, the most notable example being the alloy of aluminum with copper, manganese, and magnesium.
labels.buildingText: Some alloys are used in manufacturing support structures in some buildings and bridge frames.
labels.kitchenText: Some alloys are used in manufacturing kitchen utensils, petroleum-industry equipment, and power generation stations.

listItems: Iron and steel alloys, among the most famous alloys in use.

summary.heading: 📋 Lesson Summary
items: Alloys are used in refrigeration valves and fire-detection systems, in medicine (dental fillings and guidewires), and in aircraft frames, support structures, bridges, kitchen tools, and the petroleum industry.
Among the most famous examples: iron and steel alloys, copper-nickel or tin-cobalt alloys, lead-tin alloys, and aluminum with copper, manganese, and magnesium for aircraft frames.
